summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Lodi Shoes POS batch 3 revisions. Wrote 16 pytest cases (all passing) covering auth (3 accounts, httpOnly cookie), sales in 4 payment methods (TUNAI/QRIS/TRANSFER/DEBIT), barcode lookup + PNG, exchange flow with mixed-article targets, report/omzet mutation after exchange, transfer approval flow (pending -> approve/reject, kasir 403, re-approve 409), and two concurrency scenarios: (a) 4 parallel sales across BLR+CLD -> unique receipt numbers per branch/day + correct stock, (b) 5 parallel sales when stock=1 -> exactly one 201 + rest 409, no negative stock. Frontend smoke-tested on preview URL: login (data-testid), Dashboard, POS (Scan Kamera dialog with Kamera Live/Unggah Foto tabs, barcode Enter adds article to cart, 4 pay methods visible), Riwayat & Tukar, Label (1/2/3 kolom + Cetak), Transfer Stok (admin sees ADD form + list with DISETUJUI/DITOLAK badges from tests). All flows working; no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py's seed_history() is skipped whenever any transaction exists, so re-running seed after a session does not restore the yesterday LS-001 uk40 x3 sample. Tests now wipe collections before seeding. Consider adding a `--reset` flag or making seed idempotent for the sample tx (upsert by receipt_no).
transfers.py imports datetime and ReturnDocument but does not use them at top-level after refactor; minor cleanup.
make_receipt_no in transactions.py is atomic via counters, but exchange TUKAR uses a shared prefix TUKAR:<branch>:<day> — verified unique via unique index on receipt_no. Ok.
gross-profit report keys rows by article_id (`key`), not code. Documented in test; frontend already labels rows with `label`/`sublabel`. Consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (POS scanner + barcode Enter + Label + Transfer + Riwayat all render + interact)

seed_data_creation: Test suite wipes transactions/exchanges/transfers/counters/stock_items/articles/branches/users/sessions then re-runs /app/backend/seed.py once per session for deterministic runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py; run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_backend_api.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Serial run (`-n 0`) is required because tests share global DB state via a session-scoped wipe+reseed fixture. Camera live mode not exercised (headless env has no camera device); scanner dialog opening + tabs presence verified only, per user note.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; two initial test failures were test-only issues (seed sample not restored on re-run, and reports keyed by article_id rather than code). Both fixed in the test file.
